next_checks.rationale: Secondary supply temp tracked setpoint closely (gap up to 1.7C), but no room/radiator reading exists to confirm heat actually reached the space per the 'not enough heat' report.
Only primary network meter flow is available (first 2448, last 2348 l/h); secondary/customer circuit flow, which would show delivery capacity, is not in this replay.

Two earlier 'not enough heat'/'no heat' reports in 2016 involved heating-curve and controller parameter changes; worth checking maintenance records for any similar recent work, though prior events don't establish this cause.
